system.description:
Choose one weapon — you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and gain +1 damage with it.

  • Improves to +2 damage at 7th level, +3 at 13th and +4 at 19th
  • Weapon Training: your specialised weapon gives you its own manoeuvre, used once per round as part of a hit (still one rider per hit):
    • Bind (blades): make a Disarm contest against the target.
    • Hew (axes, maces, hammers and flails): a creature your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • Hook (spears and polearms): make a Trip contest against the target, at your weapon's full reach.
    • Pinning Fire (bows and crossbows): the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.
  • Combat Manoeuvres: Every character can use every manoeuvre; the Fighter's edge is its own manoeuvres (Weapon Training, Armour Training, Fighter Manoeuvres) and Manoeuvre Mastery. See the Combat Manoeuvres section for details.
  • Combat Reflexes: You have the Combat Reflexes feat for free (see The Feats of Arneyan in Character Creation). It doesn't use a feat slot.
